title: Cherry-picked 4-week window hiding flat 16-week series
what: Full 16-week series is flat around 100k (slope -0.11k/wk, W01->W16 -2.9k); W09-W12 +18.4% is trough-to-peak noise

reader_questions.question: What is the overall 16-week trend in weekly signups?
reader_questions.expected: Essentially flat around ~100k/week (slope -0.11k/wk; W01 = 103.2k vs W16 = 100.3k).

reader_questions.question: Why did W09–W12 look like +18.4% growth?
reader_questions.expected: W09 (89.2k) was a random single-week trough and W12 (105.6k) a normal bounce.

reader_questions.question: Should the board deck crop the x-axis to W09–W12?
reader_questions.expected: No — cropping hides 12 weeks of flat baseline and turns noise into a false growth story.
